summary: Full backend + UI e2e testing of RADHA. 11/11 pytest cases pass covering auth, register, /me, /models, conversations CRUD, per-user isolation (404 for other user, 401 unauth), and SSE streaming with real Claude tokens + persistence. UI flow verified end-to-end: login with demo@radha.ai, workspace loads with empty state + starter cards + model selector (RADHA Omni), message send streams AI reply, conversation appears in sidebar with auto-title, reload persists conversation and reloads messages on click, rename works, model switch to RADHA Swift works, delete with confirmation removes conversation, logout returns to login screen. Register path not exercised through UI (backend register verified).

issues: User message bubble has a tiny/near-invisible avatar icon next to it (see screenshot) - minor visual polish

critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') - should migrate to lifespan handler (FastAPI >=0.93).
CORS is configured with allow_credentials=True + allow_origins='*' fallback which browsers reject; harmless here because auth is bearer-based, but should be explicit origins.

Stream endpoint persists assistant message only in the generator's finally block; if client disconnects mid-stream, partial content is still saved (acceptable) but there is no cancellation token propagated to the provider - could waste tokens.

Auto-title logic runs only if existing_count==1 which is fine, but title update is not returned in SSE stream, so sidebar title in UI relies on next refresh/list call. Works in practice because conversations are re-listed after send.

No rate limiting or brute-force protection on /api/auth/login (playbook mentions lockout after 5 fails - not implemented). This app uses JWT-only (not the standard httpOnly cookie playbook), which is acceptable per spec but flagging.
test_credentials: demo@radha.ai/demo1234, other@radha.ai/other123 (seeded via register during tests)
seed_data_creation: Test users auto-registered if missing; TEST_ prefixed conversations created and cleaned up in tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend and UI flows fully green. Auth uses JWT bearer (Authorization header) stored in localStorage as radha_token. Streaming uses SSE via fetch ReadableStream. Conversations lazily created on first send. All data-testids from the request are present and working.
